instruction.name: vpickve2gr.h
instruction.description: Pick the 16-bit element at lane `idx` from `a`, sign-extend it to the GPR width, and store it in `dst`.

experiments.name: round trip through the reverse move

latencies.notes: 2 cycles of helper latency are subtracted. Unroll 10000, iters 1000. Raw measurement was 4.00; the residual is a systematic calibration offset, so the recorded value is the nominal integer with the observed spread.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
